visual_review.notes: All clips from the first H3 takes. Attack drops the smeared swing frames where an arrow flies loose (video 22-23, 39-41, 97-99), so the wind-up, strike and return snap between clean poses. Ranged jumps from full draw (41) to the snapped string (49) so the arrow is never drawn in flight. Death drops the roll onto her side (76-87), where the matte tints the white ponytail pink. Idle loops every second frame at 60 ms.
